text:
When a staff member accepts an offer, it
waits for your confirmation before the

shift is booked. This tutorial uses
fictional demonstration data.

On Offers, open the view menu and choose
Awaiting Confirmation.

Each row shows the staff member, the
shift, and when they accepted.

To confirm one offer, select the tick on
its row, check the details, then select

To confirm everyone else at once, select
Confirm All Accepted.
